title: Choose the minimal First Artifact world
question: The Threshold is the new assigned direction. Keep it, take a restrained challenger, steer again, or re-roll.

options.label: The Threshold
options.lineage: architectural thresholds and juried exhibition entrances
options.thesis: The bar becomes physical: proven work crosses a precise red threshold and aspiration does not.
options.viewport: Immense white space holds FIRST ARTIFACT and OBSESSION BEATS TALENT beside one monumental red gate; five tiny accepted artifacts sit beyond it and the application begins at the threshold.
options.risk: The restraint fails if the threshold becomes a decorative rectangle instead of a meaningful transition.

options.label: The Living Signal
options.thesis: One responsive red field makes high agency feel alive before a single section appears.
options.case: Audience identification: high. Product clarity: medium-low because atmosphere cannot prove the admission standard by itself.
options.viewport: A slowly breathing red field carries FIRST ARTIFACT, OBSESSION BEATS TALENT, one application action, and five quiet evidence coordinates at the edge.
options.risk: It can become generic creative-tech spectacle and adds performance cost without strengthening proof.

options.label: The Field Dispatch
options.lineage: expedition papers printed under impossible conditions
options.thesis: Obsession is documented in sparse dispatches from people who kept building when conditions were bad.
options.case: Audience identification: medium-high. Product clarity: strong through real member dispatches, but the historical register is less playful.
options.viewport: A nearly empty red-on-white issue opens with FIRST ARTIFACT and OBSESSION BEATS TALENT, one member dispatch, a five-name issue index, and a SEND YOUR WORK action.
options.risk: The expedition metaphor can feel solemn and may fight GoCake's playful character.

options.label: The Numbered Index
options.thesis: Every member, artifact, criterion, and event receives one direct address with no ornamental browsing.
options.case: Audience identification: medium. Product clarity: high, but it fuses poorly because teletext density and bitmap type conflict with the minimal brief and approved typography.
options.viewport: A strict numbered index labels FIRST ARTIFACT as page 001, OBSESSION BEATS TALENT as the only double-height line, five member addresses, and page 100 for APPLY.
options.risk: Its rigid nostalgia can overpower the brand and make the page feel dense rather than minimal.

canonCard.label: The polished members club
canonCard.thesis: A clean exclusive-tech-community landing page with member portraits and a direct application CTA.
canonCard.viewport: A conventional navigation bar, split hero, member grid, benefits, criteria, and application form in a familiar reading order.
canonCard.risk: Highly legible and trustworthy, but easy to confuse with every other selective founder community.
